title: Machine learning-based detection of adventitious microbes in T-cell therapy cultures using long-read sequencing
summary: A trained classifier combined with long-read sequencing detected adventitious microbial contamination in T-cell therapy cultures, including low-abundance contamination; evidence is limited to the tested culture samples.
organization: Singapore-MIT Alliance for Research and Technology , Singapore, Singapore
